summary: Timed explosives do not explode in containers

comments.content:
Timed explosives do not detonate while inside containers. Containers tested
are backpacks, gift wrapping, etc. They will, however, explode after being
removed, even if the time is way past. (i.e. you set it for 30 seconds and
remove it 5 minutes later it will explode.) Remote explosives still blow up
in containers.
